blocks.zh: Stage 2 Overview — 第二階段概覽
blocks.en: Stage 2 Overview

blocks.zh: What is Stage 2? — 第二階段是什麼？
blocks.en: What is Stage 2?

blocks.zh: 第二階段是製程確效（Process Qualification）——在此階段評估第一階段所設計的製程，判斷是否能夠實現可重複的商業規模生產。這是商業規模的概念驗證。任何實驗室或中試規模的數據，都無法取代在完整商業規模下展示製程控制能力。
blocks.en: Stage 2 is process qualification. In this stage the process designed in Stage 1 is evaluated to determine whether it is capable of reproducible commercial manufacturing. It is the proof of concept at commercial scale. No laboratory or pilot-scale data can replace a demonstration of process control at full commercial scale.

blocks.zh: FDA Source Text — 原文
blocks.en: FDA Source Text

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: Stage 2 的核心意義
blocks.en: What Stage 2 Means

blocks.zh: 兩大元素（Two Elements）
blocks.en: The Two Elements

blocks.zh: 廠房設計 + 設備/公用系統確效（Facility Design + Equipment/Utilities Qualification）
blocks.en: Facility design + qualification of equipment and utilities

blocks.zh: 製程效能確效（PPQ）——核心工作，整合所有已確效的廠房、設備、人員、材料，在商業規模下運行整個製程
blocks.en: Process performance qualification (PPQ): the core activity, which combines the qualified facility, equipment, personnel and materials to run the entire process at commercial scale

blocks.zh: 關鍵合規要求
blocks.en: Key Compliance Requirements

blocks.zh: Stage 2 期間必須全程遵循 CGMP 程序（§211.100, §211.110）
blocks.en: CGMP procedures must be followed throughout Stage 2 (§211.100, §211.110)

blocks.zh: 成功完成 Stage 2 是開始商業配銷的前提條件
blocks.en: Successful completion of Stage 2 is a prerequisite for starting commercial distribution

blocks.zh: Stage 2 生產的批次，若符合標準，可以放行上市
blocks.en: Batches made in Stage 2 that meet specifications can be released for sale

blocks.zh: 比喻：像蓋房子的驗收
blocks.en: Analogy: Handover Inspection of a New House

blocks.zh: Stage 1 是設計圖紙（Process Design）；Stage 2 則是建好房子後的全面驗收——結構安全嗎？水電正常嗎？在實際使用條件下是否運作如預期？沒有通過驗收，不能住人（不能商業配銷）。
blocks.en: Stage 1 is the blueprint (Process Design). Stage 2 is the full inspection after the house is built: Is the structure safe? Do the plumbing and electrics work? Does everything perform as expected under real conditions of use? Without passing the inspection, nobody can move in (no commercial distribution).

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Discussion Questions

blocks.zh: Stage 2 的兩大元素各自負責確認什麼？為何必須先完成第一元素才能進行第二元素？
blocks.en: What is each of the two elements of Stage 2 responsible for confirming? Why must the first element be completed before the second?

blocks.zh: FDA 說 Stage 2 批次「如果符合標準可以放行」。這對公司財務意味著什麼？
blocks.en: FDA says Stage 2 batches "can be released if they meet the criteria". What does this mean for a company's finances?

blocks.zh: CGMP 合規要求在 Stage 2 就必須滿足，這與 Stage 1（實驗室開發）有何本質差異？
blocks.en: CGMP compliance is required from Stage 2 onward. How does this differ in essence from Stage 1 (laboratory development)?

blocks.zh: IV-A: Design of Facility and Qualification of Utilities and Equipment — 廠房設計與設備/公用系統確效
blocks.en: IV-A: Design of Facility and Qualification of Utilities and Equipment

blocks.zh: 廠房設計與設備確效的三層邏輯
blocks.en: The Three-Layer Logic of Facility Design and Equipment Qualification

blocks.zh: 「確效」（Qualification）的定義
blocks.en: Definition of "Qualification"

blocks.zh: FDA 在此明確定義：確效 = 「證明設備和公用系統適合其預期用途並正常運作」的一系列活動。這不是形式上的文件填寫，而是必須有客觀證據支撐的系統性活動。
blocks.en: FDA defines qualification here as a set of activities that demonstrate that equipment and utilities are suitable for their intended use and perform properly. This is not a paperwork exercise. It is a systematic activity that must be supported by objective evidence.

blocks.zh: 無菌充填廠的實際應用
blocks.en: Practical Application in an Aseptic Fill-Finish Facility

blocks.zh: 在無菌充填廠（Aseptic Fill-Finish CDMO），設備確效對象包括：
blocks.en: In an aseptic fill-finish CDMO, the equipment and systems to be qualified include:

blocks.zh: 充填線設備：充填泵（蠕動/時間壓力式）、加塞機、壓蓋機
blocks.en: Filling line equipment: filling pumps (peristaltic / time-pressure), stoppering machines, capping machines

blocks.zh: 公用系統（Utilities）：HVAC（ISO 5/7/8 潔淨室）、注射用水（WFI）、壓縮空氣、氮氣覆蓋系統
blocks.en: Utilities: HVAC (ISO 5/7/8 cleanrooms), water for injection (WFI), compressed air, nitrogen overlay systems

blocks.zh: 滅菌設備：高壓滅菌釜（Autoclave）、隧道式乾熱滅菌箱（Depyrogenation Tunnel）
blocks.en: Sterilization equipment: autoclaves, depyrogenation tunnels (dry-heat)

blocks.zh: 隔離系統：RABS / 隔離器（Isolator）
blocks.en: Barrier systems: RABS / isolators

blocks.zh: 關鍵：廠房確效必須在 PPQ 之前完成
blocks.en: Key Point: Facility Qualification Must Be Completed Before PPQ

blocks.zh: FDA 明確指出：廠房設計確保活動（包括 Commissioning）必須先於 PPQ。邏輯很清楚：你不能在一個還沒確認水電系統是否正常的廠房裡，去確認製程是否穩定。
blocks.en: FDA states clearly that facility design assurance activities (including commissioning) must precede PPQ. The logic is straightforward: you cannot confirm that a process is stable in a facility whose utilities have not yet been confirmed to work properly.

blocks.zh: 三項確效活動對應的是我們熟知的 IQ / OQ / PQ 框架（見下方表格）——雖然 FDA 在此指引中未直接使用這些縮寫，但概念完全對應。
blocks.en: The three qualification activities correspond to the familiar IQ / OQ / PQ framework (see the table below). Although FDA does not use these abbreviations in this guidance, the concepts map directly.

blocks.zh: FDA 要求在 PPQ 之前完成廠房確效。如果你的公司 HVAC 確效還沒完成，能否先執行 PPQ？法規立場如何？
blocks.en: FDA requires facility qualification to be completed before PPQ. If your company's HVAC qualification is not yet finished, can PPQ be executed first? What is the regulatory position?

blocks.zh: 「在與例行生產相當的負載下挑戰設備」（challenging under load comparable to routine production）——在充填線的情境下，這具體代表什麼操作？
blocks.en: "Challenging under load comparable to routine production": in the context of a filling line, what does this mean in practice?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「啟停（start-up/stoppage）」和「干預（interventions）」也必須納入確效測試範圍？
blocks.en: Why must start-up/stoppage and interventions also be included in the scope of qualification testing?

blocks.zh: IQ / OQ / PQ Linkage to Process Design — 確效三步驟與製程設計的關聯
blocks.en: IQ / OQ / PQ Linkage to Process Design

blocks.zh: FDA Source Activities — 三項確效活動（原文對應）
blocks.en: FDA Source Activities

blocks.zh: IQ/OQ/PQ 中文詳解 — 無菌充填廠情境
blocks.en: IQ/OQ/PQ Explained: Aseptic Fill-Finish Scenario

blocks.zh: IQ → OQ → PQ 的邏輯鏈
blocks.en: The IQ → OQ → PQ Logic Chain

blocks.zh: IQ 確認「裝對了」→ OQ 確認「動得對」→ PQ 確認「在真實生產下表現穩定」。每一步都建立在前一步的基礎上。跳過任何一步，後續的 PPQ 結論都缺乏基礎。
blocks.en: IQ confirms it is installed correctly, OQ confirms it operates correctly, and PQ confirms it performs consistently under real production conditions. Each step builds on the one before. If any step is skipped, the conclusions of the subsequent PPQ have no foundation.

blocks.zh: CDMO 現實挑戰
blocks.en: CDMO Reality Check

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，客戶要求快速啟動新產品，但設備確效（特別是新充填線的 OQ）往往比預期耗時。若 IQ/OQ 未完成就試圖執行 PPQ，既違反 FDA 指引，也將導致 PPQ 數據無效。
blocks.en: In a CDMO, customers want new products started quickly, but equipment qualification (especially OQ for a new filling line) often takes longer than expected. Attempting PPQ before IQ/OQ is complete both violates the FDA guidance and renders the PPQ data invalid.

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 確效計畫五要素
blocks.en: Commentary: Five Elements of a Qualification Plan

blocks.zh: 確效計畫（Qualification Plan）必要內容
blocks.en: Required Content of a Qualification Plan

blocks.zh: 五項必要要素
blocks.en: Five Required Elements

blocks.zh: 測試/研究內容：要做哪些測試？（例：充填量準確度、HVAC 粒子計數、WFI 電導率）
blocks.en: Studies/tests to be conducted: What tests will be performed? (e.g., fill volume accuracy, HVAC particle counts, WFI conductivity)

blocks.zh: 判定標準：合格的定義是什麼？（例：充填量偏差 <±2%，USP <797> 粒子限制）
blocks.en: Acceptance criteria: What defines a pass? (e.g., fill volume deviation <±2%, USP <797> particle limits)

blocks.zh: 時程安排：各項確效活動的順序與時程
blocks.en: Timing: the sequence and schedule of the qualification activities

blocks.zh: 部門職責：工程部、品保部、製造部各自的責任
blocks.en: Responsibilities: the duties of Engineering, Quality Assurance and Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 文件與核准程序：如何記錄？誰來審查核准？
blocks.en: Documentation and approval procedures: How is it recorded? Who reviews and approves?

blocks.zh: Quality Unit 的角色 — §211.22
blocks.en: Role of the Quality Unit: §211.22

blocks.zh: FDA 明確要求：品質部門必須審查並核准確效計畫和報告。品保不只是蓋章，而是主動參與確效標準的制定與結果的評估。在稽核中，FDA 調查員會直接檢查 QU 的審查記錄。
blocks.en: FDA explicitly requires the quality unit to review and approve qualification plans and reports. QA does not merely stamp documents; it takes an active part in setting the qualification criteria and evaluating the results. In an inspection, FDA investigators will check the QU's review records directly.

blocks.zh: 風險管理融入確效計畫
blocks.en: Integrating Risk Management into the Qualification Plan

blocks.zh: FDA 允許用風險管理（Risk Management）來優先排序確效活動並確定工作深度。例如：對直接接觸產品的設備（充填針、充填泵）給予最高優先級和最嚴格測試；對間接系統（壓縮空氣閥門）可採用較簡化的確效方式。這體現了 ICH Q9 基於風險的思維。
blocks.en: FDA allows risk management to be used to prioritize qualification activities and determine the depth of the work. For example, product-contact equipment (filling needles, filling pumps) receives the highest priority and the most rigorous testing, while indirect systems (compressed air valves) may be qualified with a simplified approach. This reflects the risk-based thinking of ICH Q9.

blocks.zh: 你的公司正在導入一條新的充填線。請列出至少 5 個需要確效的公用系統（Utilities），並按照風險高低排序。
blocks.en: Your company is introducing a new filling line. List at least five utilities that need to be qualified and rank them from highest to lowest risk.

blocks.zh: FDA 要求確效計畫包含「變更評估的要求」。這對設備確效後的日常維護有什麼影響？
blocks.en: FDA requires the qualification plan to include requirements for change evaluation. What does this mean for routine maintenance after equipment qualification?

blocks.zh: 品質部門必須核准確效計畫——如果工程部未諮詢 QU 就執行了某些確效測試，這在稽核中會產生什麼問題？
blocks.en: The quality unit must approve the qualification plan. If Engineering ran some qualification tests without consulting the QU, what problems would this cause in an inspection?

blocks.zh: IV-B: Process Performance Qualification (PPQ) — 製程效能確效概論
blocks.en: IV-B: Process Performance Qualification (PPQ)

blocks.zh: PPQ 的本質：整合驗證
blocks.en: The Essence of PPQ: Integrated Verification

blocks.zh: PPQ 是什麼的整合？
blocks.en: What Does PPQ Integrate?

blocks.zh: PPQ 將以下所有元素整合在一起，在商業規模下運行：
blocks.en: PPQ brings all of the following elements together and runs them at commercial scale:

blocks.zh: 已確效的廠房（Qualified Facility）
blocks.en: Qualified facility

blocks.zh: 已確效的公用系統（Qualified Utilities）
blocks.en: Qualified utilities

blocks.zh: 已確效的設備（Qualified Equipment）
blocks.en: Qualified equipment

blocks.zh: 訓練合格的人員（Trained Personnel）
blocks.en: Trained personnel

blocks.zh: 商業製造製程（Commercial Manufacturing Process）
blocks.en: Commercial manufacturing process

blocks.zh: 製程控制程序（Control Procedures）
blocks.en: Control procedures

blocks.zh: 商業原料/組件（Commercial Components）
blocks.en: Commercial components

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 PPQ 必須在設備確效之後——你無法用未確效的設備來確效製程。
blocks.en: This is why PPQ must follow equipment qualification: you cannot qualify a process using unqualified equipment.

blocks.zh: 核心立場：商業規模數據才算數
blocks.en: Core Position: Only Commercial-Scale Data Count

blocks.zh: FDA 明確指出：「開始商業配銷的決定，必須有商業規模批次數據的支持。」實驗室和中試數據只能提供「額外保證」，不能作為主要依據。
blocks.en: FDA states clearly: "the decision to begin commercial distribution must be supported by data from commercial-scale batches." Laboratory and pilot data can provide only "additional assurance" and cannot serve as the primary basis.

blocks.zh: 這直接回應了業界常見的誤解：3 批 10 公升的實驗批次數據，不能代替商業規模的 PPQ。
blocks.en: This directly addresses a common industry misconception: data from three 10-liter experimental batches cannot substitute for commercial-scale PPQ.

blocks.zh: 規模效應（Scale Effects）
blocks.en: Scale Effects

blocks.zh: FDA 要求製造商考慮「規模效應」（effects of scale）。在無菌充填廠中，這特別重要：
blocks.en: FDA requires manufacturers to consider the "effects of scale". This is especially important in aseptic fill-finish:

blocks.zh: 配製槽攪拌：從 50L 放大到 500L，混合動力學完全不同
blocks.en: Compounding tank agitation: scaling from 50 L to 500 L changes the mixing dynamics completely

blocks.zh: 過濾時間：商業規模的過濾面積和壓差與小試完全不同
blocks.en: Filtration time: the filter area and differential pressure at commercial scale are completely different from small-scale trials

blocks.zh: 充填速度：高速充填下的充填量均勻性與低速小批次不同
blocks.en: Filling speed: fill volume uniformity at high speed differs from that of low-speed small batches

blocks.zh: 環境暴露時間（LST/BIER）：商業批次的最長暴露時間可能遠長於小批次
blocks.en: Environmental exposure time (LST/BIER): the maximum exposure time of a commercial batch may be much longer than that of a small batch

blocks.zh: 比喻：廚師做菜 vs. 餐廳量產
blocks.en: Analogy: A Chef vs. Restaurant Mass Production

blocks.zh: 一位廚師在廚房試做了 3 份完美的餐點（Stage 1 開發）。但餐廳開業前，必須證明同樣的食譜在商業廚房、由訓練過的廚師、用商業規模的設備，能持續產出同樣品質——這就是 PPQ。你不能說「試做時很好所以一定沒問題」。
blocks.en: A chef makes three perfect dishes in the kitchen as a trial (Stage 1 development). Before the restaurant opens, however, it must be shown that the same recipe, in a commercial kitchen, prepared by trained cooks using commercial-scale equipment, consistently produces the same quality. That is PPQ. You cannot say "the trial went well, so it will surely be fine".

blocks.zh: PPQ 整合了七個元素。哪個元素最容易被忽略？在無菌充填廠中，「訓練合格的人員」對 PPQ 結果有什麼影響？
blocks.en: PPQ integrates seven elements. Which one is most easily overlooked? In an aseptic fill-finish facility, how do "trained personnel" affect PPQ results?

blocks.zh: FDA 說「不必在商業規模探索整個操作範圍，如果設計數據能提供保證」——這個條件在實際操作中如何判斷？
blocks.en: FDA says it is not necessary to explore the entire operating range at commercial scale if design data provide assurance. How is this condition judged in practice?

blocks.zh: 「以往對類似產品/製程的可信賴經驗也有幫助」——在 CDMO 環境中，如何將平台製程（Platform Process）的歷史數據用於支持新產品的 PPQ？
blocks.en: Relevant prior experience with similar products/processes also helps. In a CDMO, how can historical data from a platform process be used to support the PPQ of a new product?

blocks.zh: IV-C: PPQ Protocol Requirements — PPQ 方案要素
blocks.en: IV-C: PPQ Protocol Requirements

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — PPQ 方案要素深度解析
blocks.en: Commentary: In-Depth Analysis of PPQ Protocol Elements

blocks.zh: PPQ 方案：書面承諾的力量
blocks.en: PPQ Protocol: The Power of a Written Commitment

blocks.zh: 為什麼書面方案如此重要？
blocks.en: Why Is a Written Protocol So Important?

blocks.zh: PPQ 方案是「事前承諾」（Pre-specified Commitment）。你必須在執行前就定義好：做什麼測試、收什麼數據、合格標準是什麼。這防止了「做完再決定標準」（Cherry-picking）的問題。FDA 稽核時會比對方案與實際執行是否一致。
blocks.en: The PPQ protocol is a pre-specified commitment. Before execution you must define which tests will be run, what data will be collected and what the acceptance criteria are. This prevents cherry-picking, that is, deciding on the criteria after the work is done. During an FDA inspection, the protocol is compared with what was actually executed.

blocks.zh: PPQ 方案要素清單（8 項）
blocks.en: PPQ Protocol Element Checklist (8 Items)

blocks.zh: 製造條件：操作參數、加工限制、原料投入規格
blocks.en: Manufacturing conditions: operating parameters, processing limits and raw material (component) inputs

blocks.zh: 數據收集計畫：收集什麼、何時收、如何評估
blocks.en: Data collection plan: what is collected, when, and how it is evaluated

blocks.zh: 測試項目與接受標準：製程中測試、放行測試、特性鑑定測試
blocks.en: Tests and acceptance criteria: in-process tests, release tests and characterization tests

blocks.zh: 取樣計畫：取樣點、樣品數量、頻率（比例行生產更密集）
blocks.en: Sampling plan: sampling points, number of samples and frequency (more intensive than routine production)

blocks.zh: 製程效能指標：科學/風險決策依據，含統計方法
blocks.en: Process performance criteria: scientific/risk-based basis for decisions, including statistical methods

blocks.zh: 廠房/設備確效狀態確認（若尚未完成）
blocks.en: Confirmation of facility/equipment qualification status (if not yet completed)

blocks.zh: 分析方法確效狀態確認
blocks.en: Confirmation of analytical method validation status

blocks.zh: 方案的部門審查與 QU 核准記錄
blocks.en: Review by relevant departments and QU approval records for the protocol

blocks.zh: 數據排除的嚴格要求
blocks.en: Strict Requirements for Excluding Data

blocks.zh: FDA 特別強調：「PPQ 數據不得在未有有文件記錄的、以科學為基礎的正當理由的情況下排除於進一步考量之外。」這意味著你不能因為某個數據點「看起來像異常值」就輕易捨棄——必須有完整的 OOS/OOT 調查支撐。
blocks.en: FDA emphasizes: "PPQ data must not be excluded from further consideration without a documented, scientifically sound justification." This means you cannot casually discard a data point just because it "looks like an outlier". A complete OOS/OOT investigation must support the decision.

blocks.zh: 無菌充填廠 PPQ 方案範例要素
blocks.en: Example Elements of an Aseptic Fill-Finish PPQ Protocol

blocks.zh: 操作參數：充填速度（例：300 瓶/分）、充填量（例：10.0 mL ± 0.2 mL）、加塞力（例：20-40 N）、壓蓋扭矩
blocks.en: Operating parameters: filling speed (e.g., 300 vials/min), fill volume (e.g., 10.0 mL ± 0.2 mL), stoppering force (e.g., 20-40 N), capping torque

blocks.zh: 製程中測試：每 30 分鐘充填量抽查、沉降碟 EM、浮游菌採樣、容器完整性（CCIT 先期測試）
blocks.en: In-process tests: fill weight checks every 30 minutes, settle plate EM, viable air sampling, container closure integrity (preliminary CCIT)

blocks.zh: 放行測試：無菌（§71.3a/直接法）、可見異物（100% 燈檢）、pH、效價、CCIT
blocks.en: Release tests: sterility (§71.3a / direct inoculation), visible particulates (100% light inspection), pH, potency, CCIT

blocks.zh: 接受標準：所有批次符合成品規格；無菌培養基模擬（APS）生長單元 = 0；每批製程能力指數 Ppk ≥ 1.33
blocks.en: Acceptance criteria: all batches meet finished product specifications; aseptic process simulation (APS) growth-positive units = 0; process capability index Ppk ≥ 1.33 for each batch

blocks.zh: PPQ 方案必須包含「分析方法確效狀態確認」。如果某個分析方法在 PPQ 執行時還沒有完成確效，對 PPQ 的合規性有何影響？
blocks.en: The PPQ protocol must include confirmation of analytical method validation status. If an analytical method has not been validated when PPQ is executed, what is the impact on the compliance of the PPQ?

blocks.zh: 方案中要求「QU 核准」——如果 PPQ 過程中發現需要修改一個操作參數，必須怎麼做？
blocks.en: The protocol requires QU approval. If an operating parameter needs to be changed during PPQ, what must be done?

blocks.zh: 數據不得無正當理由排除。假設某批次中有一個充填量數據明顯偏低，如何合規地處理這個數據點？
blocks.en: Data must not be excluded without justification. Suppose one fill volume result in a batch is clearly low. How should this data point be handled in a compliant manner?

blocks.zh: Enhanced Sampling Rationale — 強化取樣的理由
blocks.en: Enhanced Sampling Rationale

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 為什麼 PPQ 需要比例行生產更多樣品？
blocks.en: Commentary: Why Does PPQ Need More Samples Than Routine Production?

blocks.zh: 強化取樣的根本理由
blocks.en: The Fundamental Rationale for Enhanced Sampling

blocks.zh: 核心邏輯：你在學習，不是在確認
blocks.en: Core Logic: You Are Learning, Not Confirming

blocks.zh: 例行生產的取樣計畫，是建立在「製程已被證明穩定」的前提下設計的。PPQ 的前提恰恰相反：你還不知道這個商業規模製程是否穩定——你正在蒐集足夠的數據來証明它穩定。因此需要更多樣品。
blocks.en: The sampling plan for routine production is designed on the premise that the process has already been shown to be stable. The premise of PPQ is exactly the opposite: you do not yet know whether this commercial-scale process is stable, and you are collecting enough data to demonstrate that it is. Hence more samples are needed.

blocks.zh: 三個統計理由
blocks.en: Three Statistical Reasons

blocks.zh: 批內均勻性（Intra-batch Uniformity）：需要足夠多的樣品，才能偵測到批次內部的變異（例如充填線起始/中段/結尾的充填量差異）
blocks.en: Intra-batch uniformity: enough samples are needed to detect variation within a batch (e.g., differences in fill volume between the start, middle and end of the filling run)

blocks.zh: 批間變異（Inter-batch Variability）：需要跨多批次的數據，才能估計批間變異並建立容忍區間
blocks.en: Inter-batch variability: data across multiple batches are needed to estimate between-batch variation and establish tolerance intervals

blocks.zh: 統計信心水準（Statistical Confidence Level）：樣品數越多，對製程能力的估計越精確，信心區間越窄
blocks.en: Statistical confidence level: the more samples, the more precise the estimate of process capability and the narrower the confidence interval

blocks.zh: 比喻：氣象預報的道理
blocks.en: Analogy: How Weather Forecasting Works

blocks.zh: 例行天氣預報用 3 個氣象站的數據就夠（因為已有數十年數據建立了模型）。但如果你要第一次為某個新城市建立天氣預報模型，你需要在各個位置、各個時段密集布點測量——這就是 PPQ 的強化取樣邏輯。
blocks.en: A routine weather forecast needs data from only three weather stations, because decades of data have already built the model. But if you are building a forecast model for a new city for the first time, you need to take dense measurements at many locations and many times. This is the logic of enhanced sampling in PPQ.

blocks.zh: 強化取樣可基於風險分析調整
blocks.en: Enhanced Sampling Can Be Adjusted Based on Risk Analysis

blocks.zh: FDA 說「信心水準可基於風險分析」——這表示不同屬性的取樣強度可以不同：
blocks.en: FDA says the "confidence level can be based on risk analysis", which means the sampling intensity can differ between attributes:

blocks.zh: 高風險屬性（例：無菌性、可見異物）→ 最高取樣密度
blocks.en: High-risk attributes (e.g., sterility, visible particulates) → highest sampling density

blocks.zh: 中風險屬性（例：充填量、pH）→ 標準加密取樣
blocks.en: Medium-risk attributes (e.g., fill volume, pH) → standard increased sampling

blocks.zh: 低風險屬性（例：外觀、標籤）→ 適度強化即可
blocks.en: Low-risk attributes (e.g., appearance, labeling) → moderate enhancement is sufficient

blocks.zh: 無菌充填廠：PPQ 強化取樣舉例
blocks.en: Aseptic Fill-Finish: Examples of Enhanced PPQ Sampling

blocks.zh: 以一個 10,000 瓶的 PPQ 批次為例：
blocks.en: Take a PPQ batch of 10,000 vials as an example:

blocks.zh: 充填量：例行每 30 分鐘查 10 瓶 → PPQ 每 15 分鐘查 20 瓶（覆蓋充填線前/中/後）
blocks.en: Fill volume: routine, 10 vials every 30 minutes → PPQ, 20 vials every 15 minutes (covering the start, middle and end of the filling run)

blocks.zh: 沉降碟：例行灌裝時間的 50% → PPQ 全程（100%）擺放沉降碟
blocks.en: Settle plates: routine, exposed for 50% of the filling time → PPQ, exposed for the entire run (100%)

blocks.zh: CCIT：例行每批抽取 n=30 → PPQ 每批抽取 n=100
blocks.en: CCIT: routine, n=30 per batch → PPQ, n=100 per batch

blocks.zh: 可見異物：100% 燈檢（兩者相同，因本就是全數檢驗）
blocks.en: Visible particulates: 100% light inspection (same in both cases, since this is already a full inspection)

blocks.zh: 你的 PPQ 方案規定每 15 分鐘抽查充填量 20 瓶。執行中發現這個頻率造成大量操作干擾，想改為每 30 分鐘查 10 瓶。這個改變需要什麼程序？
blocks.en: Your PPQ protocol specifies 20 vials checked for fill volume every 15 minutes. During execution you find that this frequency causes significant operational disruption and want to change to 10 vials every 30 minutes. What procedure does this change require?

blocks.zh: 強化取樣何時可以停止？FDA 說「應持續到適當的製程確認階段」——在你的公司，這個決定如何做出？
blocks.en: When can enhanced sampling stop? FDA says it "should continue until there is sufficient data to determine" the appropriate level. How is this decision made in your company?

blocks.zh: 決定強化取樣持續時間的四個考量因素（生產量、製程複雜度、理解程度、類似產品經驗），在無菌充填廠中哪個最難量化？為什麼？
blocks.en: Of the four factors that determine the duration of enhanced sampling (production volume, process complexity, level of understanding, experience with similar products), which is the hardest to quantify in an aseptic fill-finish facility, and why?

blocks.zh: PPQ vs. Routine Production Comparison — PPQ 與例行生產取樣比較表
blocks.en: PPQ vs. Routine Production Comparison: Sampling

blocks.zh: Statistical Methods for PPQ — PPQ 的統計方法
blocks.en: Statistical Methods for PPQ

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 統計工具深度說明
blocks.en: Commentary: Statistical Tools in Depth

blocks.zh: PPQ 的兩個核心統計工具
blocks.en: Two Core Statistical Tools for PPQ

blocks.zh: 工具 1：容忍區間（Tolerance Interval, TI）
blocks.en: Tool 1: Tolerance Interval (TI)

blocks.zh: 定義：在一定置信度（例如 95%）下，能夠覆蓋至少某一比例（例如 99%）的製程輸出的區間。
blocks.en: Definition: an interval that, at a given confidence level (e.g., 95%), covers at least a given proportion (e.g., 99%) of the process output.

blocks.zh: 用途：用來確認製程產出的大部分產品（不只是樣品）都落在規格限制內。
blocks.en: Purpose: to confirm that most of the product produced by the process (not just the samples) falls within the specification limits.

blocks.zh: 與規格的差別：規格告訴你「可接受範圍」；容忍區間告訴你「實際製程分布有多少落在這個範圍內」。
blocks.en: Difference from specifications: a specification tells you the "acceptable range"; a tolerance interval tells you how much of the actual process distribution falls within that range.

blocks.zh: 解讀範例：如果 95/99 容忍區間（95% 置信度，覆蓋 99% 的產品）為 [9.8 mL, 10.2 mL]，而規格是 9.5–10.5 mL，則製程通過。若容忍區間超出規格，製程能力不足。
blocks.en: Interpretation example: if the 95/99 tolerance interval (95% confidence, covering 99% of the product) is [9.8 mL, 10.2 mL] and the specification is 9.5–10.5 mL, the process passes. If the tolerance interval extends beyond the specification, the process capability is insufficient.

blocks.zh: 工具 2：製程效能指數（Ppk）
blocks.en: Tool 2: Process Performance Index (Ppk)

blocks.zh: 定義：Ppk = min[(USL - X̄) / 3σ, (X̄ - LSL) / 3σ]，其中 σ 為樣品整體標準差（含批間變異）
blocks.en: Definition: Ppk = min[(USL - X̄) / 3σ, (X̄ - LSL) / 3σ], where σ is the overall standard deviation of the samples (including between-batch variation)

blocks.zh: 與 Cpk 的差別：Cpk 使用製程內部變異（組內）；Ppk 使用整體變異（含批間），更保守，更適合 PPQ 的「長期能力估計」。
blocks.en: Difference from Cpk: Cpk uses within-process (within-subgroup) variation, whereas Ppk uses overall variation (including between-batch variation). It is more conservative and better suited to the "long-term capability estimate" of PPQ.

blocks.zh: FDA 建議標準：業界一般要求 PPQ 階段 Ppk ≥ 1.33（對應 Sigma Level ≈ 4），或依風險和產品屬性設定更嚴格的標準。
blocks.en: Commonly applied standard: industry generally expects Ppk ≥ 1.33 at the PPQ stage (corresponding to a sigma level of about 4), or a stricter standard set according to risk and product attributes.

blocks.zh: 無菌充填廠應用：充填量 Ppk、容器密封完整性（CCIT 測試結果）、pH 等關鍵質量屬性（CQA）都應計算 Ppk。
blocks.en: Application in aseptic fill-finish: Ppk should be calculated for critical quality attributes (CQAs) such as fill volume, container closure integrity (CCIT results) and pH.

blocks.zh: 批內 vs 批間變異的分析
blocks.en: Analysis of Intra-Batch vs. Inter-Batch Variation

blocks.zh: FDA 明確要求統計方法必須定義「批內（intra-batch）和批間（inter-batch）變異」：
blocks.en: FDA explicitly requires the statistical methods to address "intra-batch and inter-batch variability":

blocks.zh: 批內：同一批次內不同時間點/位置的變異（例如充填量的批內漂移）
blocks.en: Intra-batch: variation across time points/locations within the same batch (e.g., drift in fill volume within a batch)

blocks.zh: 批間：不同批次之間的均值/標準差差異（例如每批充填量平均值是否一致）
blocks.en: Inter-batch: differences in means/standard deviations between batches (e.g., whether the mean fill volume is consistent from batch to batch)

blocks.zh: 兩者都必須在規格內且可控，製程才算真正穩定。
blocks.en: Both must be within specification and under control for the process to be considered truly stable.

blocks.zh: 你的 PPQ 批次充填量數據計算得 Ppk = 1.18，規格為 9.5–10.5 mL，均值 10.0 mL，Ppk 未達 1.33。這是否代表 PPQ 失敗？應如何決策？
blocks.en: The fill volume data of your PPQ batch give Ppk = 1.18, with a specification of 9.5–10.5 mL and a mean of 10.0 mL. Ppk does not reach 1.33. Does this mean PPQ has failed? How should the decision be made?

blocks.zh: 容忍區間（TI）和 Ppk 都可以衡量製程能力，但它們各自強調不同方面。各舉一個情境說明何時用 TI 更合適，何時用 Ppk 更合適。
blocks.en: Tolerance intervals (TI) and Ppk can both measure process capability, but each emphasizes a different aspect. Give one scenario in which TI is more suitable and one in which Ppk is more suitable.

blocks.zh: FDA 說「僅建議（strongly recommend）」使用統計指標——這代表不用也合規嗎？從稽核的角度，不使用統計方法有什麼風險？
blocks.en: FDA says it "strongly recommends" the use of statistical metrics. Does this mean not using them is still compliant? From an inspection standpoint, what are the risks of not using statistical methods?

blocks.zh: PPQ Protocol Execution — PPQ 方案執行要求
blocks.en: PPQ Protocol Execution

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 執行的合規要求
blocks.en: Commentary: Compliance Requirements for Execution

blocks.zh: PPQ 執行的三大合規要求
blocks.en: Three Major Compliance Requirements for PPQ Execution

blocks.zh: 要求 1：先核准，再執行
blocks.en: Requirement 1: Approve First, Then Execute

blocks.zh: PPQ 方案必須在所有相關部門（含 QU）審查核准後，才能開始執行。這不是走過場的簽名——是正式的書面核准。執行前開始意味著違規（§211.100）。
blocks.en: The PPQ protocol must be reviewed and approved by all relevant departments (including the QU) before execution begins. This is not a token signature but formal written approval. Starting execution before approval is a violation (§211.100).

blocks.zh: 要求 2：偏離必須事先核准
blocks.en: Requirement 2: Deviations Must Be Approved in Advance

blocks.zh: 如果執行中需要偏離方案，必須依照既定程序或方案中的規定處理，並在實施前獲得所有相關部門和 QU 的批准。「先做再說」在 PPQ 是不被允許的。
blocks.en: If a deviation from the protocol is needed during execution, it must be handled according to established procedures or as provided in the protocol, and approved by all relevant departments and the QU before implementation. "Act first, explain later" is not permitted in PPQ.

blocks.zh: 要求 3：真實商業條件下執行
blocks.en: Requirement 3: Execution Under Real Commercial Conditions

blocks.zh: PPQ 批次必須：
blocks.en: PPQ batches must:

blocks.zh: 遵循商業製造製程和例行程序（不能用特殊程序）
blocks.en: Follow the commercial manufacturing process and routine procedures (no special procedures)

blocks.zh: 由日常操作該製程的人員執行（不能用「最優秀的員工」操作）
blocks.en: Be executed by the personnel who normally operate the process (not "the best employees")

blocks.zh: 在正常操作條件下進行（HVAC、WFI、原料、環境均為正常狀態）
blocks.en: Be run under normal operating conditions (HVAC, WFI, raw materials and environment all in their normal state)

blocks.zh: 常見錯誤：PPQ 用特殊安排
blocks.en: Common Mistake: Special Arrangements for PPQ

blocks.zh: 有些公司 PPQ 期間用最資深的員工操作、特別清潔設備、選用最佳批次原料——這些都違背了「正常條件」的要求。PPQ 結果應代表平均水準下的製程能力，而非最優狀況。如果只有在特殊安排下才能通過，這個製程本質上是不穩定的。
blocks.en: Some companies use their most senior staff, clean the equipment especially thoroughly, or select the best raw material lots during PPQ. All of these violate the requirement for "normal conditions". PPQ results should represent process capability at average performance, not at the best case. If the process can pass only under special arrangements, it is inherently unstable.

blocks.zh: 比喻：駕照路考的道理
blocks.en: Analogy: The Driving Test

blocks.zh: PPQ 就像駕照路考。不能讓最頂尖的賽車手去代考（不是日常操作人員），不能用特改的賽道（不是正常條件）。考官要看的是一般駕駛員在正常道路上的正常水準。
blocks.en: PPQ is like a driving test. You cannot send a top racing driver to take the test for you (not the routine operators), and you cannot use a specially modified track (not normal conditions). The examiner wants to see how an ordinary driver performs on an ordinary road.

blocks.zh: PPQ 執行中，操作員發現充填針有輕微堵塞，需要比方案規定更換充填針的時間提前 2 小時。依 FDA 指引，此時應如何處理？
blocks.en: During PPQ execution, an operator finds slight clogging of a filling needle and needs to change it 2 hours earlier than the protocol specifies. How should this be handled under the FDA guidance?

blocks.zh: 「由日常操作該製程的人員執行」——在 CDMO 環境中，如果 PPQ 剛好在某位關鍵操作員請假時進行，是否應該延後 PPQ？如何在方案中預先規定這種情況？
blocks.en: PPQ must be executed by the personnel who normally operate the process. In a CDMO, if PPQ happens to coincide with a key operator being on leave, should PPQ be postponed? How can such a situation be pre-specified in the protocol?

blocks.zh: 正常操作條件要求使用「商業原料」。如果 PPQ 使用的某個原料批次後來發現有品質問題，這對 PPQ 結論有何影響？
blocks.en: Normal operating conditions require the use of commercial raw materials. If a raw material lot used in PPQ is later found to have a quality problem, what is the impact on the PPQ conclusions?

blocks.zh: PPQ Report Requirements — PPQ 報告要求
blocks.en: PPQ Report Requirements

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — PPQ 報告的六大要素
blocks.en: Commentary: Six Elements of the PPQ Report

blocks.zh: PPQ 報告：最終的書面結論
blocks.en: The PPQ Report: The Final Written Conclusion

blocks.zh: PPQ 報告結構清單（6 項）
blocks.en: PPQ Report Structure Checklist (6 Items)

blocks.zh: 方案交叉對照：逐一對照方案要素，確認執行狀況
blocks.en: Cross-reference to the protocol: compare each protocol element one by one and confirm its execution status

blocks.zh: 數據彙總與分析：依方案要求的統計方法分析所有數據
blocks.en: Data summary and analysis: analyze all data using the statistical methods required by the protocol

blocks.zh: 所有不符合項彙總：偏差、異常事件、OOS 結果，並與製程控制結論連結
blocks.en: Summary of all nonconformances: deviations, unexpected events and OOS results, linked to the conclusions on process control

blocks.zh: 矯正措施描述：已採取或需採取的 CAPA
blocks.en: Description of corrective actions: CAPA taken or required

blocks.zh: 明確結論：製程處於受控狀態，或不在受控狀態（含後續行動計畫）
blocks.en: Clear conclusion: the process is in a state of control, or it is not (with a follow-up action plan)

blocks.zh: 相關部門及 QU 的審查與核准
blocks.en: Review and approval by the relevant departments and the QU

blocks.zh: 關鍵：結論必須明確，不能模糊
blocks.en: Key Point: The Conclusion Must Be Clear, Not Vague

blocks.zh: PPQ 報告的結論只有兩種：
blocks.en: There are only two possible conclusions for a PPQ report:

blocks.zh: 製程處於受控狀態（可開始商業配銷）
blocks.en: The process is in a state of control (commercial distribution may begin)

blocks.zh: 製程不在受控狀態（必須說明需要的矯正措施和時程）
blocks.en: The process is not in a state of control (the required corrective actions and timelines must be stated)

blocks.zh: 含糊的結論（例如「大部分結果符合要求」）不被接受。
blocks.en: Vague conclusions (e.g., "most results meet the requirements") are not acceptable.

blocks.zh: 不符合項必須全部記錄並關聯結論
blocks.en: All Nonconformances Must Be Recorded and Linked to the Conclusion

blocks.zh: FDA 要求：所有偏差、異常事件、OOS 結果都必須：
blocks.en: FDA requires that all deviations, unexpected events and OOS results must be:

blocks.zh: 在報告中被完整彙總（不能選擇性呈現）
blocks.en: Fully summarized in the report (no selective presentation)

blocks.zh: 與製程控制狀態結論明確連結（例如：這個偏差是否影響製程受控狀態的判斷）
blocks.en: Explicitly linked to the conclusion on the state of process control (e.g., does this deviation affect the judgment that the process is in a state of control?)

blocks.zh: 這與 OOS 調查的要求一致：數據不能未經科學正當理由就被忽視。
blocks.en: This is consistent with OOS investigation requirements: data cannot be disregarded without scientific justification.

blocks.zh: PPQ 報告「及時準備」的實際意義
blocks.en: What "Timely Preparation" of the PPQ Report Means in Practice

blocks.zh: FDA 說報告應「在方案完成後及時準備」。業界一般理解為：
blocks.en: FDA says the report should be prepared in a timely manner after the protocol is completed. The industry generally interprets this as:

blocks.zh: 初稿：批次完成後 30 天內
blocks.en: Draft: within 30 days after the batches are completed

blocks.zh: QU 核准版：60 天內
blocks.en: QU-approved version: within 60 days

blocks.zh: 批次放行必須等 PPQ 報告核准（至少要有初步結論）
blocks.en: Batch release must wait for PPQ report approval (at least a preliminary conclusion is needed)

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，客戶通常急於知道 PPQ 結果，這造成快速完成報告的壓力，但不應為此犧牲報告的完整性。
blocks.en: In a CDMO, customers are usually eager to know the PPQ results, which creates pressure to finish the report quickly, but the completeness of the report should not be sacrificed for speed.

blocks.zh: PPQ 報告顯示製程有 2 個輕微偏差（已 CAPA）和 1 個 OOS（已調查，判定為實驗室錯誤）。報告的結論應如何撰寫？
blocks.en: A PPQ report shows two minor deviations (CAPA completed) and one OOS (investigated and attributed to laboratory error). How should the conclusion of the report be written?

blocks.zh: 「及時準備」——如果 PPQ 報告尚未完成 QU 核准，是否可以放行 PPQ 批次？FDA 的立場是什麼？
blocks.en: On "timely preparation": if the PPQ report has not yet been approved by the QU, can the PPQ batches be released? What is FDA's position?

blocks.zh: PPQ 報告需要「所有相關部門」核准。在你的組織中，哪些部門應該在 PPQ 報告上簽名？為什麼每個部門都有責任？
blocks.en: The PPQ report requires approval by "all relevant departments". In your organization, which departments should sign the PPQ report? Why does each department carry responsibility?

blocks.zh: PAT: Process Analytical Technology — 製程分析技術的 PPQ 方法
blocks.en: PAT: Process Analytical Technology

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — PAT 製程的不同 PPQ 邏輯
blocks.en: Commentary: The Different PPQ Logic for PAT Processes

blocks.zh: PAT 製程的根本差異
blocks.en: The Fundamental Difference of PAT Processes

blocks.zh: 什麼是 PAT（製程分析技術）？
blocks.en: What is PAT (Process Analytical Technology)?

blocks.zh: PAT 是一種即時製程控制策略：在製程運行過程中，連續測量關鍵物料屬性（CMA），並根據即時測量結果主動調整製程參數，使製程輸出始終維持在目標品質水準。
blocks.en: PAT is a real-time process control strategy: while the process is running, critical material attributes (CMAs) are measured continuously, and process parameters are actively adjusted based on the real-time measurements so that the process output stays at the target quality level.

blocks.zh: 常見範例：近紅外光譜（NIR）監測混合均勻度 → 達到均勻度標準時自動停止混合（終點控制，而非固定時間）
blocks.en: Common example: near-infrared (NIR) spectroscopy monitors blend uniformity, and mixing stops automatically when the uniformity criterion is reached (endpoint control rather than fixed time)

blocks.zh: PAT 製程 PPQ 的焦點轉移
blocks.en: The Shift in Focus of PPQ for PAT Processes

blocks.zh: 傳統製程 PPQ 重點：確認固定製程條件下的輸出穩定性
blocks.en: Traditional process PPQ focus: confirm the stability of output under fixed process conditions

blocks.zh: PAT 製程 PPQ 重點：確認測量系統和控制閉環（Control Loop）的可靠性
blocks.en: PAT process PPQ focus: confirm the reliability of the measurement system and the control loop

blocks.zh: 具體而言：
blocks.en: Specifically:

blocks.zh: NIR 模型是否準確？（量測系統確效）
blocks.en: Is the NIR model accurate? (measurement system validation)

blocks.zh: 控制邏輯是否正確響應？（控制迴路測試）
blocks.en: Does the control logic respond correctly? (control loop testing)

blocks.zh: 在異常情況下的響應是否符合預期？（故障模式測試）
blocks.en: Is the response under abnormal conditions as expected? (failure mode testing)

blocks.zh: PAT 在無菌充填廠的潛在應用
blocks.en: Potential PAT Applications in Aseptic Fill-Finish

blocks.zh: 充填量即時監控：重量感測器（In-line weighing）即時偵測每瓶充填量，異常時自動停線
blocks.en: Real-time fill volume monitoring: in-line weighing detects the fill volume of every vial in real time and stops the line automatically when an abnormality occurs

blocks.zh: 配製濃度監控：UV/Vis 或 NIR 即時監測 API 濃度，達到目標後停止配製
blocks.en: Compounding concentration monitoring: UV/Vis or NIR monitors API concentration in real time, and compounding stops when the target is reached

blocks.zh: 容器完整性即時偵測：高壓放電（HVLD）100% 偵測密封完整性
blocks.en: Real-time container integrity detection: high voltage leak detection (HVLD) checks seal integrity on 100% of units

blocks.zh: 目前無菌充填廠的 PAT 應用仍在逐步推廣，但趨勢明確。
blocks.en: PAT applications in aseptic fill-finish are still being rolled out gradually, but the trend is clear.

blocks.zh: 不變的核心目標
blocks.en: The Unchanged Core Objective

blocks.zh: 無論使用傳統 PPQ 還是 PAT 方法，目標都一樣：「建立科學證據，證明製程具有重現性並能持續提供優質產品。」PAT 只是改變了如何達到這個目標的方法，而不是改變目標本身。
blocks.en: Whether traditional PPQ or a PAT approach is used, the objective is the same: "to establish scientific evidence that a process is reproducible and will consistently deliver quality products". PAT changes how this objective is achieved, not the objective itself.

blocks.zh: 傳統 PPQ 和 PAT-based PPQ 的取樣策略有什麼根本差別？為什麼 PAT 製程可以用不同的取樣方式？
blocks.en: What is the fundamental difference between the sampling strategies of traditional PPQ and PAT-based PPQ? Why can a PAT process use a different sampling approach?

blocks.zh: 如果你的充填線導入了 In-line 充填量即時監控（PAT），PPQ 方案中如何規定測量系統確效的要求？
blocks.en: If your filling line adopts in-line real-time fill volume monitoring (PAT), how would the PPQ protocol specify the requirements for measurement system validation?

blocks.zh: PAT 允許製程即時自我調整——這是否與「固定製程條件」的傳統 PPQ 概念相矛盾？如何在法規框架下理解這個差異？
blocks.en: PAT allows the process to adjust itself in real time. Does this contradict the traditional PPQ concept of "fixed process conditions"? How should this difference be understood within the regulatory framework?

blocks.zh: What Happens When PPQ Fails — PPQ 失敗時怎麼辦？
blocks.en: What Happens When PPQ Fails

blocks.zh: Regulatory Basis — 法規基礎
blocks.en: Regulatory Basis

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — PPQ 失敗的合規後果與應對
blocks.en: Commentary: Compliance Consequences of PPQ Failure and the Response

blocks.zh: PPQ 失敗的定義與後果
blocks.en: Definition and Consequences of PPQ Failure

blocks.zh: 何謂「PPQ 失敗」？
blocks.en: What Is "PPQ Failure"?

blocks.zh: PPQ 失敗不只是「某瓶不合格」——它是指 PPQ 報告的結論無法支持「製程處於受控狀態」的判斷。這可能發生在：
blocks.en: PPQ failure is not just "one vial did not pass". It means that the conclusion of the PPQ report cannot support the judgment that "the process is in a state of control". This can occur in situations such as:

blocks.zh: 多個批次的 Ppk < 1.33（系統性能力不足）
blocks.en: Ppk < 1.33 across multiple batches (systematic lack of capability)

blocks.zh: 批間變異過大（製程不具重現性）
blocks.en: Excessive inter-batch variation (the process is not reproducible)

blocks.zh: 有未解決的 OOS 且根本原因指向製程設計缺陷
blocks.en: An unresolved OOS whose root cause points to a process design flaw

blocks.zh: 關鍵偏差（Critical Deviation）發生且無法證明不影響產品品質
blocks.en: A critical deviation occurs and it cannot be shown that product quality was unaffected

blocks.zh: PPQ 失敗的法規後果
blocks.en: Regulatory Consequences of PPQ Failure

blocks.zh: 不得商業配銷：PPQ 未成功完成，不能開始商業配銷
blocks.en: No commercial distribution: commercial distribution cannot begin unless PPQ is successfully completed

blocks.zh: 已生產批次的處置：若 PPQ 批次因不符合規格而無法放行，必須依 §211.192 進行全面調查
blocks.en: Disposition of batches already produced: if a PPQ batch cannot be released because it fails specifications, a thorough investigation must be conducted under §211.192

blocks.zh: 重新 PPQ：進行必要的製程改善後，必須重新執行 PPQ（或部分 PPQ）
blocks.en: Repeat PPQ: after the necessary process improvements, PPQ must be re-executed (in full or in part)

blocks.zh: FDA 通報：若 NDA/ANDA 已申報，製程重大變更可能需要補充申請
blocks.en: Notification to FDA: if an NDA/ANDA has been filed, a major process change may require a supplement

blocks.zh: PPQ 失敗後的標準處理流程
blocks.en: Standard Handling Procedure After PPQ Failure

blocks.zh: 偏差調查：識別所有不符合項，進行根本原因分析（RCA）
blocks.en: Deviation investigation: identify all nonconformances and perform root cause analysis (RCA)

blocks.zh: 範圍界定：確認失敗是局部性的（操作失誤）還是系統性的（製程設計缺陷）
blocks.en: Scoping: determine whether the failure is localized (operator error) or systemic (process design flaw)

blocks.zh: CAPA 制定：制定有時程的矯正預防措施
blocks.en: CAPA development: establish corrective and preventive actions with timelines

blocks.zh: 製程改善：依 CAPA 修改製程設計或控制策略（可能需要回到 Stage 1）
blocks.en: Process improvement: modify the process design or control strategy per the CAPA (this may require returning to Stage 1)

blocks.zh: 重新 PPQ：再次執行完整或部分 PPQ，並撰寫新報告
blocks.en: Repeat PPQ: execute full or partial PPQ again and write a new report

blocks.zh: 法規評估：評估是否需要更新申請文件
blocks.en: Regulatory assessment: evaluate whether the filing documents need to be updated

blocks.zh: CDMO 視角：PPQ 失敗的商業影響
blocks.en: CDMO Perspective: Commercial Impact of PPQ Failure

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，PPQ 失敗的影響遠超技術層面：客戶的上市時程延遲、緊急採購成本、客戶關係緊張、可能的合約違約條款——這些都是真實的商業後果。這正是為什麼 Stage 1 的製程設計品質如此關鍵：做好前端設計，才能減少 Stage 2 失敗的風險。
blocks.en: In a CDMO, the impact of PPQ failure goes far beyond the technical: delays to the customer's launch timeline, emergency procurement costs, strained customer relationships and possible breach-of-contract clauses. These are real commercial consequences. This is exactly why the quality of process design in Stage 1 is so critical: a well-done front-end design reduces the risk of failure in Stage 2.

blocks.zh: 比喻：橋梁結構測試
blocks.en: Analogy: Structural Testing of a Bridge

blocks.zh: PPQ 就像橋梁開放前的最終結構測試。如果測試失敗，橋不能通車（不能商業配銷）。你需要找出哪裡有結構問題（根本原因），修復它，然後重新測試。你不能說「算了，先通車再說，希望不會塌」——這在藥品生產中就是危及患者安全。
blocks.en: PPQ is like the final structural test before a bridge opens. If the test fails, the bridge cannot be opened to traffic (no commercial distribution). You must find where the structural problem lies (root cause), fix it and test again. You cannot say "never mind, open it first and hope it doesn't collapse". In drug manufacturing, that would endanger patient safety.

blocks.zh: PPQ 三批次中，第二批次有一個 OOS（充填量偏低），調查後確認是操作員充填針安裝錯誤（人員錯誤，非製程設計問題），已 CAPA。PPQ 是否可以繼續？結論如何撰寫？
blocks.en: In a three-batch PPQ, the second batch has an OOS result (low fill volume). The investigation confirms that the operator installed the filling needle incorrectly (human error, not a process design problem), and CAPA is complete. Can PPQ continue? How should the conclusion be written?

blocks.zh: PPQ 後發現批間 Ppk = 1.12（目標 1.33），但每批批內均勻性良好。這代表什麼？根本原因最可能在哪裡？
blocks.en: After PPQ, the inter-batch Ppk is found to be 1.12 (target 1.33), but intra-batch uniformity is good in every batch. What does this indicate? Where is the root cause most likely to be?

blocks.zh: 客戶要求「縮短 PPQ 批次數量，只做 2 批」以節省成本。作為 CDMO 品保主管，你如何回應這個要求？你會引用 FDA 指引的哪個部分？
blocks.en: A customer asks to "reduce the number of PPQ batches to just two" to save cost. As the CDMO QA head, how do you respond? Which part of the FDA guidance would you cite?

blocks.zh: Concurrent Release — 同步放行（簡要說明）
blocks.en: Concurrent Release (Brief Overview)

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 同步放行的條件與風險
blocks.en: Commentary: Conditions and Risks of Concurrent Release

blocks.zh: 什麼是同步放行（Concurrent Release）？
blocks.en: What Is Concurrent Release?

blocks.zh: 定義
blocks.en: Definition

blocks.zh: 同步放行是指在 PPQ 尚未完全完成（例如跨批次分析和報告尚在進行）的情況下，將符合規格的個別 PPQ 批次放行到市場。FDA 在 Stage 2 允許此做法，但有前提條件。
blocks.en: Concurrent release means releasing individual PPQ batches that meet specifications to the market before PPQ is fully complete (for example, while the cross-batch analysis and report are still in progress). FDA allows this practice in Stage 2, subject to conditions.

blocks.zh: 同步放行的條件
blocks.en: Conditions for Concurrent Release

blocks.zh: 該批次必須符合所有成品規格（放行測試通過）
blocks.en: The batch must meet all finished product specifications (release testing passed)

blocks.zh: 製造商對製程有足夠的理解，能夠預期批次品質
blocks.en: The manufacturer has sufficient understanding of the process to predict batch quality

blocks.zh: 須有充分的科學和風險評估支持此決策
blocks.en: Adequate scientific and risk assessment must support the decision

blocks.zh: Stage 3（持續製程確認）的計畫必須已就位
blocks.en: The plan for Stage 3 (continued process verification) must already be in place

blocks.zh: 注意：Stage 3 有更完整的說明
blocks.en: Note: Stage 3 Provides More Detail

blocks.zh: FDA 在 Stage 2 僅簡短提及同步放行的可行性。完整的同步放行策略、條件和風險評估要求，在 Stage 3（持續製程確認）部分有更詳盡的說明。在 CDMO 工作時，通常需要與客戶的法規事務部門共同評估是否採用同步放行策略。
blocks.en: FDA mentions the feasibility of concurrent release only briefly in Stage 2. The complete strategy, conditions and risk assessment requirements for concurrent release are covered in more detail in Stage 3 (continued process verification). When working in a CDMO, you will usually need to evaluate with the customer's regulatory affairs department whether to adopt a concurrent release strategy.

blocks.zh: Risk-Based Justification for Enhanced Sampling — 強化取樣的風險基礎正當理由
blocks.en: Risk-Based Justification for Enhanced Sampling

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 如何建立風險基礎取樣計畫
blocks.en: Commentary: How to Build a Risk-Based Sampling Plan

blocks.zh: 風險分層取樣的實際操作
blocks.en: Practical Operation of Risk-Tiered Sampling

blocks.zh: 文件化正當理由的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of Documented Justification

blocks.zh: 每一個取樣決策都應有書面的風險評估支持。稽核時，FDA 可能會問：「為什麼每批 CCIT 只取 50 個樣品？」你需要能夠引用基於風險的正當理由，而不是說「因為以前都這樣做」。
blocks.en: Every sampling decision should be supported by a written risk assessment. In an inspection, FDA may ask: "Why do you take only 50 samples per batch for CCIT?" You need to be able to cite a risk-based justification, not say "because we have always done it this way".

blocks.zh: 根據上表，如果你的 PPQ 只有有限的預算可以強化取樣，你會優先在哪個屬性上投入最多資源？請用風險矩陣的邏輯說明理由。
blocks.en: Based on the table above, if your PPQ has only a limited budget for enhanced sampling, on which attribute would you invest the most resources? Explain your reasoning using risk matrix logic.

blocks.zh: FDA 說信心水準可以基於風險分析——這是否意味著「低風險屬性」可以不做 PPQ 取樣？這條線在哪裡？
blocks.en: FDA says the confidence level can be based on risk analysis. Does this mean "low-risk attributes" can be left out of PPQ sampling altogether? Where is the line?

blocks.zh: 「以往對類似產品的經驗」可以減少 PPQ 的取樣要求——在 CDMO 平台製程的語境下，如何運用歷史批次數據來支持降低取樣強度的決策？
blocks.en: Prior experience with similar products can reduce PPQ sampling requirements. In the context of a CDMO platform process, how can historical batch data be used to support a decision to reduce sampling intensity?

blocks.zh: Key Message — 核心訊息
blocks.en: Key Message

blocks.zh: 第二階段是商業規模的概念驗證——你無法用小規模數據蒙混過關。
blocks.en: Stage 2 is the proof of concept at commercial scale. You cannot bluff your way through with small-scale data.

blocks.zh: 三批優秀的小規模數據，無法取代一次嚴格執行的商業規模 PPQ。FDA 的立場毫不含糊：開始商業配銷的決定，必須有商業規模批次數據的支持。實驗室和中試數據是補充，不是替代。
blocks.en: Three excellent small-scale batches cannot replace one rigorously executed commercial-scale PPQ. FDA's position is unambiguous: the decision to begin commercial distribution must be supported by data from commercial-scale batches. Laboratory and pilot data are supplementary, not a substitute.

blocks.zh: 強化取樣不是官僚主義的繁文縟節——它是你建立統計基礎的方式，而這個基礎正是你在 Stage 3 降低監控強度的正當理由。你現在投資於證據，才能換來未來以標準監控水準運作的權利。
blocks.en: Enhanced sampling is not bureaucratic red tape. It is how you build the statistical foundation that justifies reducing the intensity of monitoring in Stage 3. By investing in evidence now, you earn the right to operate at a standard monitoring level in the future.

blocks.zh: Section Summary — 本節重點回顧
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 中文重點整理
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: Stage 2 的八個核心記憶點
blocks.en: Eight Core Points of Stage 2

blocks.zh: 兩大元素，有序進行：先廠房/設備/公用系統確效，才能進行 PPQ，沒有例外
blocks.en: Two elements, in sequence: qualify the facility/equipment/utilities first, then perform PPQ, with no exceptions

blocks.zh: IQ→OQ→PQ 邏輯鏈：裝對了→動得對→穩定表現，環環相扣
blocks.en: The IQ→OQ→PQ logic chain: installed correctly → operates correctly → performs consistently, each link depending on the last

blocks.zh: PPQ 方案是事前承諾：所有測試、標準、統計方法必須在執行前就定義好
blocks.en: The PPQ protocol is a pre-specified commitment: all tests, criteria and statistical methods must be defined before execution

blocks.zh: 強化取樣有其理由：PPQ 是學習階段，需要更多數據來描述商業規模的變異特性
blocks.en: Enhanced sampling has a rationale: PPQ is a learning phase and needs more data to characterize variability at commercial scale

blocks.zh: 統計工具：TI + Ppk：批內和批間變異都必須被處理
blocks.en: Statistical tools: TI + Ppk: both intra-batch and inter-batch variation must be addressed

blocks.zh: PPQ 報告結論必須明確：受控或不受控，不能模糊
blocks.en: The PPQ report conclusion must be clear: in control or not in control, never vague

blocks.zh: PAT = 不同方法，同樣目標：重點轉向量測系統和控制迴路的確效
blocks.en: PAT = a different method, the same objective: the focus shifts to qualification of the measurement system and control loop

blocks.zh: 失敗 = 重新來過：PPQ 未成功完成，不得商業配銷
blocks.en: Failure = start again: commercial distribution is not permitted unless PPQ is successfully completed

blocks.zh: 面試/稽核必答問題
blocks.en: Must-Answer Questions for Interviews/Inspections

blocks.zh: Q: 為什麼 PPQ 需要比例行生產更多樣品？
blocks.en: Q: Why does PPQ need more samples than routine production?

blocks.zh: A: 因為 PPQ 是首次在商業規模下運行製程，沒有歷史數據可依賴。我們需要足夠的數據來建立對「批內和批間品質均勻性」的統計信心，並為 Stage 3 的例行取樣計畫建立基準線。
blocks.en: A: Because PPQ is the first time the process is run at commercial scale, and there is no historical data to rely on. We need enough data to build statistical confidence in "intra-batch and inter-batch quality uniformity" and to establish a baseline for the routine sampling plan in Stage 3.
